name: Ontario Mills
description: Ontario Mills is one of California's largest outlet shopping destinations, featuring over 200 brand-name outlet stores offering deep discounts on everything from fashion to home goods. This massive indoor mall combines outlet shopping with entertainment venues including a 30-screen AMC theater, Dave & Buster's, and diverse dining options. Located in Ontario's tourist corridor near the airport and major freeways, it serves as a premier value shopping destination for the Inland Empire and Southern California.
demographics: Ontario Mills attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic with families and bargain hunters making up the majority of visitors. The trade area draws from the Inland Empire region, serving middle-income households seeking discounted brand-name merchandise and entertainment options. Visitors typically range from young families to millennials, with a strong Hispanic and multi-ethnic customer base reflective of the surrounding Southern California communities. Shopping patterns emphasize weekend visits and extended stays due to the center's entertainment offerings including a movie theater and dining options.
summary: Ontario Mills is Southern California's premier outlet shopping destination with over 200 brand-name stores and major entertainment venues under one massive roof.
